acceptance: Verify actual callers and existing constraints; if an existing shared transaction/lock already serializes all reachable calls, record counterevidence instead of inventing a bug.
No lost independent check-in/mileage increments, no stale writeback of unrelated counters, and safe first-row contention under the existing schema.
Preserve each valid onNodeDone call increment, checkins/5+1 level, existing streak/timezone and topic-completion badge/mileage contract; no new dedup identity or reward policy.
Read APIs remain ordinary reads; any new write-only locking query is opt-in, with documented transaction/lock order and real-MySQL cases written but not run.
No DDL/new index/new dependency/Redis lock/member-points or money mapper edit; missing constraints/identity/policy are explicit blockers, never fake badges or silent successful fallbacks.
